summary: Certified Human Resources Professional with extensive employee relations experience in a full range of functions, as well as success in simultaneously managing multiple projects.

experience.title: HR Coordinator
responsibilities: Managed recruitment, selection, and staffing for full‑time employees.
Oversaw employee orientation and onboarding for full‑time staff.
Maintained job classification system with descriptions, objectives, and salary benchmarks.
Developed and administered personnel policies, procedures, and programs for the City.
Advised managers and employees on labor contracts, employment law, and policy matters.
Investigated complaints and facilitated conflict resolution.
Collaborated with departments on employee performance, behavior, and productivity issues.
Handled compensation, benefits, and performance management duties.
Managed City safety and workers’ compensation processes.
Served as Chair of Benefit, Safety, and Wellness committees, ensuring compliance and program development.
Developed and administered leave of absence programs (FMLA, Salary Continuation, Parenting Leave, Military Leave).
Conducted research, prepared reports, and recommended solutions for complex HR issues.
Led special projects on HR initiatives, including software implementation, process improvements, training programs, onboarding, and exit interview processes.

experience.title: Independent HR Contractor
responsibilities: Assisted HR with internal employee website mapping for benefits and company information.
Supported mapping project for Room & Board sales staff.

experience.title: Human Resource Assistant / HR Generalist
responsibilities: Screened applicants, coordinated interview schedules, and prepared information packets.
Sent offer letters and verified paperwork.
Staffed contractor positions and facilitated orientation for contract employees.
Conducted new hire orientations for all employees.
Collaborated with management on employee relations issues.
Conducted exit interviews and processed termination paperwork.
Provided training and communication on HR programs, benefits, and processes.
Administered leaves of absence, short‑term disability, and workers’ compensation.
Managed tuition reimbursement program.

experience.title: Receptionist / Administrative Assistant
responsibilities: Maintained corporate phone list, EEO information, bus pass, and stamp inventories in Excel.
Ordered and approved office supply orders.
Coordinated with Memorial Blood Centers for NRG/ATT Blood Drive recruitment.
Oversaw security badge process.
Completed assigned special projects on time.

projects.name: Orientation Process Revamp
projects.description: Revamped the orientation process for all new hires, implementing a company‑wide standardized program.

projects.name: Passive Open Enrollment Process
projects.description: Introduced the first passive open enrollment process for benefits administration.
